   Sports Keaton Mitchell Week 10 Preview vs. the Ravens
 Nov 15, 2026 Keaton Mitchell has a decent matchup when his Los Angeles Chargers face the Baltimore Ravens in Week 10 (Monday, 8:15 p.m. ET). The Ravens have conceded 99.9 rushing yards per game, 11th in the NFL.
 On the ground, Mitchell has 178 rushing yards on 46 attempts (22.3 ypg). As a pass-catcher, Mitchell has tallied 18 catches for 103 yards (12.9 ypg) and one touchdown.
 Listen to the game on ALT 98.7 
 Mitchell vs. the Ravens
 Mitchell vs the Ravens (since 2021): No games
 No player has put up more than 100 yards on the ground in a game against the Ravens in the 2026 season.
 Baltimore has allowed one or more rushing TDs to 11 opposing players this year.
 Only one opposing rusher has scored two or more TDs on the ground against the Ravens this season.
 The run defense of the Ravens is allowing 99.9 yards per contest on the ground this year, which ranks 11th in the NFL.
 The Ravens' defense ranks 30th in the league with 12 rushing TDs allowed so far this year.
 Catch NFL action all year long on Fubo. 
 Mitchell Rushing Insights
 Mitchell has hit the over on his rushing yards totals in four games (50.0%) out of eight opportunities.
 The Chargers pass on 52.0% of their plays and run on 48.0%. They are 32nd in NFL action in points scored.
 He has carried the ball in 46 of his team's 224 total rushing attempts this season (20.5%).
 In eight games this season, Mitchell has not yet rushed for a touchdown.
 He has scored one of his team's 11 offensive touchdowns this season (9.1%).
 He has four red zone carries for 14.8% of the team share (his team runs on 49.1% of its plays in the red zone).
